scope: Read-only evidence inventory for UDM (WRF mp_physics=27) precipitation radiative support. No production source was changed for this inventory.

findings.udm_native_units: WRF Registry declares qs, qg, qh as kg kg-1 mixing ratios.
findings.ccpp_generic_mapping: The pinned CCPP GFS cloud_mp_uni maps slot 4 to snow + graupel when ncnd > 2. Its path is grid-mean g m-2 from mixing ratio and layer pressure thickness; it does not divide by cloud fraction. For supplied effective radii, it supplies only cld_resnow (snow effective radius), not separate graupel size.
findings.ccpp_mapping_scope: This is the generic cloud_mp_uni mapping, not universal to all CCPP host mappings. The same pinned source's cloud_mp_thompson maps slot 4 from snow only.
findings.udm_native_snow_radius: udm_mp_effective_radius accepts qs but not qg/qh and computes re_qs from qs, air density, temperature-dependent n0s, then clips the radius to [25, 999] micrometres. It is therefore not a size parameterization for qs+qg or hail.
findings.hail_radiative_mapping: No qh/hail field or hail optical coefficients are present in the inspected pinned CCPP RRTMGP LW/SW interfaces or generic cloud mapping. WRF UDM supplies qh and a native hail PSD, but no hail radiative effective radius or validated shortwave/longwave optical mapping was found in the inspected public primary sources.
findings.hail_options: Published research demonstrates possible hail optical approaches (e.g. band-fitted Mie properties in SOCRATES; Mie on equivalent effective-radius spheres in an EarthCARE UV-IR simulator), but neither is a validated drop-in UDM/CCPP/RRTMGP coefficient mapping. A qh-to-snow proxy or coefficients cannot be justified from these sources.
remaining_inputs_for_a_validated_hail_mo: particle-size distribution choice and its relation to UDM qh, N0h, density, and air density
particle habit/shape and bulk density assumptions
ice refractive index versus wavelength and temperature, including liquid coating/melting treatment
effective radius or size-bin definition consistent with the chosen PSD
spectrally integrated extinction, single-scattering albedo, asymmetry/phase function remapped to the target RRTMGP bands
validation against independent observations or a trusted radiative transfer dataset

sources.evidence: This UFS application pin points to NCAR/ccpp-physics commit 3e6660c6df54e95a0871e990c2294dd397ae3860.

sources.source: Hill et al. (2018), Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems, DOI 10.1029/2018MS001415
sources.evidence: Research parameterizes rain/graupel/hail single-scattering properties using Mie theory and fits extinction, SSA, and asymmetry by SOCRATES spectral bands. This is not an RRTMGP/UDM-validated coefficient set.

sources.source: Donovan et al. (2023), Atmospheric Measurement Techniques 16, 5327-5350
sources.evidence: The EarthCARE simulation system describes UV-IR graupel/hail optics from Mie calculations on equivalent effective-radius spheres, while noting limitations in phase functions. It does not define an UDM-to-RRTMGP mapping.

interpretation_limit: The generic CCPP snow+graupel slot is evidence for a particular host path, not proof that mapping UDM qg into an existing RRTMGP snow optical parameter is physically equivalent. Existing UDM qs-only radius cannot establish the effective radius of a qs+qg mixture. No public qh-to-optics mapping was identified in the bounded source set.
